items: Runes for telekinetic grab or a lockpick
rec: Monastery with Combat Bracelet or Edgeville glory teleport

st.t: Talk to Gossip, just south of the Sinclair Mansion.
s: How curious. Maybe I should investigate it.

st.t: Talk to the Guard in the Sinclair Manor.
Long-press the east window of the mansion, choose Break, and go in through it.
Pick up the scrap paper.
Go upstairs.
Pick up the address form.
Search the west bookcase for a black knight helm.
Go down the staircase.
Step out of the window.
Return to the guard with the 3 items.
s: I have proof that the Sinclairs have left.
I have proof that links the Sinclairs to Camelot.
I have proof of foul play.

st.t: Ask Gossip all 3 chat options.
Talk to Anna in the Seers' Village Court House.
s: Okay, I guess I don't have much of a choice.

st.t: Go down the stairs to the court room.
Talk to the judge to call the Dog Handler and ask them about the poison.
Talk to the judge to call the Butler and ask them about the dagger.
Talk to the judge to call the Maid and ask them about the night of the murder.
Ask anyone about the thread.
Leave the court room.
Talk to Anna in the Seers' Village Court House.

Walk east around Camelot Castle, past the gate, then to the north-east, near the temple. Search the statue there. Don't tap the screen during the cutscene that follows, or you'll have to watch it again.
i: Runes for telekinetic grab or a lockpick

st.t: Talk to Merlin.
Reach for the vent on the north wall.

If you already have a lockpick, skip this step. Otherwise, use telekinetic grab on the guard grooming their hair to get a hair clip. If you have no runes either, talk to the knights in the room. They can give you a lockpick, or the runes for the grab.
Attempt to open the cell door.
Pick the door's lock.
Go through the cell door to come out on the ground floor of Keep Le Faye, then climb the stairs to the top floor of the keep.
Search the table and take the purple round box.
Talk to Wizard Cromperty in the north-east of East Ardougne.

i: Runes for telekinetic grab or a lockpick

st.t: Enter the Black Knight Fortress wearing the bronze med helm and iron chainbody.
Put on the black knight armour, then push the wall just north of the door to enter the secret room.
Enter the Black Knight Fortress basement.
Free King Arthur by using the animate rock scroll.
Talk to King Arthur in the basement.
Talk to King Arthur in Camelot to finish the quest.
